author: human
content: Publish-Aggregate-Consume Protocol: Each agent writes durable artifacts to ~/.<agent>/portal-out/ on closeout. portal-sync merges into ~/_portal/graph.jsonl. Agents consume filtered by scope+phase on startup. No agent writes directly to the shared surface.

author: human
content: Phase-Transition Membrane: 'shared' vs 'local' is a phase position on the ephemeral→durable axis, not a storage location. Every artifact moves along this axis by publish rules. The membrane is the set of transition rules, not a directory boundary.

author: human
content: Projection Pluralism: atoms, plans, IRF items, and pipeline entries are not four kinds of thing — they are four phases of the same thing at different positions on the work-status axis. The four registries are lower-dimensional projections of one lattice.

author: human
content: Serena fork retired. Serena-agent from PyPI (serena-agent package, v1.5.3+) is the canonical source. The fork at git+https://github.com/oraios/serena is deprecated.

author: human
content: Agent triage: Claude is primary workhorse (builds, architects, ships). Codex is secondary (code generation, debugging, tests). Gemini is tertiary (research, multimodal, Google-integrated tasks). All three should work and consume the graph. No agent is deprecated.

author: human
content: PORTVS is a protocol, not a directory. The graph.jsonl is the canonical surface. The entrance.md describes the protocol. Per-agent outboxes are transient. No agent writes to the shared surface directly — only portal-sync does.

author: human
content: Never-Delete Law: Memory is never trimmed-as-in-discarded. Unique data gets versioned and retired, never deleted. Every node carries version and supersedes/superseded_by chains. Nothing leaves the lattice — archive is the final resting phase.

author: human
content: Nothing Local-Only (Rule #2): Every artifact must be git-tracked AND pushed. The graph is the authoritative copy. Per-agent outboxes are transient — they exist only until portal-sync aggregates them into the canonical graph.

author: human
content: Plans Are Artifacts (Rule #5): After writing a plan, commit and push it. Plans become graph nodes with phase=draft→proposed→accepted→done. A plan that stays in ephemeral/draft without promotion joins the orphan rate. Closeout is the promotion ritual.

author: human
content: Fix Bases, Not Outputs (Rule #6): Modify the source/template/pipeline, never the rendered/generated artifact. The graph is the source. Per-agent config files are rendered outputs derived from the graph on SessionStart.

author: human
content: Atomic Commits (Rule #11): One DONE-NNN per commit. Bundle only inseparable items. The graph node's id serves as the commit reference — each node promotion is an atomic operation.

author: human
content: No Stubs/TODOs/Placeholders (Tier-0 Liturgy): Full implementations only. Every graph node at phase=accepted or higher carries complete, actionable content. Draft nodes may be incomplete but must carry enough context to be resumable.

author: human
content: Memory Is Hypothesis (Tier-0 Liturgy): Any state recalled from a previous session MUST be verified against current disk state before acting. The graph is the verification surface — query it on startup to confirm recalled state matches canonical state.

author: human
content: IRF-SYS-189 (P2, G1): No FK between four parallel work registries (atom registry, plans, IRF, pipeline task queue). RESOLVED by graph unification — the four registries are projections of one lattice; the phase field provides referential integrity without foreign keys.

IRF-SYS-190 (P1, G2): ~/_dot-config/ umbrella has no remote. CLOSED: _dot-config dissolved into PORTVS. Name retired per 2026-06-01 plan. Surviving references point to ~/_portal/config/_dot-config/. Zero active hooks depend on it. Skill that referenced _dot-config/scratch already migrated canonical copy internally.
author: claude
human
content: Premortem finding F5 (Claude hook format break) was a FALSE ALARM. Claude's SessionStart hooks use '|| true' with stdout capture, not JSON parsing. Plain-text output is correct. The format simplification from chezmoi 'overwrite all' did NOT break Claude.

author: human
content: Premortem finding F2 (LSP jetsam) is ACTIVE RISK. Only python+typescript+lua enabled in .serena/project.yml. 16GB M5 Tahoe has logged jetsam kills. Add LSPs incrementally, monitor memory_pressure, never batch-add.

author: human
content: Expansive Inquiry finding: The four work registries (atoms, plans, IRF, pipeline-queue) are lower-dimensional projections of ONE lattice. The lifting dimension is work-status-as-phase (ephemeral→durable). This graph.jsonl is the unified lattice. IRF-SYS-189 (no foreign keys) is dissolved, not fixed — foreign keys weren't needed; the phase axis provides referential integrity.
Phase 2 wired: Claude SessionStart consumes graph, SessionEnd runs portal-sync. Full publish-aggregate-consume cycle operational for Claude.
author: claude

content: Mail product deployed to Cloudflare Workers: https://universal-mail-automation-demo.ivixivi.workers.dev — dashboard loads, /health returns 200. Deployed via wrangler from ~/Code/organvm/universal-mail--automation. Worker serves both static assets (web/index.html) and API endpoints.

content: Session closeout 2026-06-02: Full cascaded roadmap complete. All 7 phases done. PORTVS graph at 27 nodes with 20 tests passing. Mail product live. Claude+Codex hooks wired. Serena on PyPI. Two PRs open: domus #55 (ready to merge). 4 repos committed and pushed. 3 remaining post-roadmap items: legacy registry migration, Gemini consume mechanism, mail product demo data.
